tips.text: Craft the five Mutagen Mass before the Paracyst build; the recipe takes Mass, not Mutagen Samples.
Queue all five Mutagen Mass crafts at once the moment the 50 samples are in hand; they run in parallel.
Expect clan research to be slow; if you are the only active member, you donate every resource yourself.
Start the next 72-hour research step the moment the last one finishes; the timers are the longest part.
Treat it as an easy Mastery weapon; there is no RNG gate and the only grind is Mutagen Sample.
